Title: Authorizes the department of social services to provide certain notice to providers when written authorization has been provided by the provider or person receiving such notice
Summary: Authorizes the department of social services to provide certain notice to providers when written authorization has been provided by the provider or person receiving such notice.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to authorizing the department of social services to provide certain notice by electronic means when written authorization has been provided by the person receiving such notice
